sloka: तस्मात्पुराद्दुहितरं गृहीत्वा वनमागतः ।इयं ममात्मजा राजंस्तस्याः कुक्षौ विवर्धिता ।। ७.१२.१० ॥
transliteration: tasmātpurādduhitaraṁ gṛhītvā vanamāgataḥ ।iyaṁ mamātmajā rājaṁstasyāḥ kukṣau vivardhitā ।। 7.12.10 ॥

translations.english: Having taken my daughter from that city, I came to the forest; this is my daughter, O King, who grew in her womb.
